notes: Hand-curated synthetic fixture for the early-career full-stack developer archetype. One ExpectedUnit per fact-bearing bullet in the EXPERIENCE section. Side projects are short-form descriptions without bullets and are intentionally not labeled.

expected_units.normalized_summary: Rebuilt KYC verification flow from a 12-step linear form into a resumable saved-state wizard, cutting median completion time from 9m12s to 4m48s and reducing abandonment past step 3 by 31%
Owned Knex to Drizzle ORM migration across 47 query sites, authored a codemod handling 80% of rewrites, shipped behind per-route flag with zero rollbacks
Built document-upload pipeline with S3 presigned URLs, ClamAV virus scanning, AWS Textract OCR, and structured field extraction; ~14k docs/week at 99.7% success and $0.06/doc vs prior $0.42
Designed append-only audit-log service with row-level hashing, structured event taxonomy, and Retool dashboard for compliance, replacing a manual quarterly CSV-export workflow
Led React 18 to 19 upgrade across ~140 components in the onboarding app, coordinating Suspense boundaries with design and refactoring legacy class components without customer-visible regressions

Shipped seller-onboarding redesign moving from a 23-field single form to a progressive 4-step flow with inline validation and Stripe Connect embedded onboarding; lifted started-to-first-listing conversion from 38% to 61%
Built search-results page on Algolia with faceted filters, saved searches, cursor-paginated infinite scroll, and SSR shell — Lighthouse score from 54 to 86
Migrated GraphQL gateway from Apollo Server v3 to v4 and introduced persisted queries, cutting p95 payload size 62% and removing two recurring mobile rate-limit incidents
Owned zero-downtime move from Heroku Postgres to AWS RDS using logical replication, authored the runbook used for subsequent migrations
Built internal admin tool for trust-and-safety listing review and account actions, replacing four Retool boards plus a spreadsheet for ~30 daily users
Built schema-validation layer for incoming customer events using Pydantic and a diff-against-registered-schemas check, rolled out across 12 customer integrations
Built Slack bot surfacing data-quality alerts from Great Expectations runs to the on-call channel; still in production at end of internship
